en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with multi‑story historic buildings. On the right is a long arcaded façade; further down the street stands a decorated building with four corner turrets and patterned walls. On the left corner is a shop with a sign bearing the name "Adolf" and another word. People are visible on the sidewalk and looking out of an upper‑floor window. The printed caption at the top reads "Kamenz i. Sa. - Kirchstraße".
